products.body:
The bold and colourful Stanley IceFlow™ Flip Straw Tumblers are made to keep you hydrated in a fully functional style. Ideal for your commute or workout, it has a built-in flip straw for easy and effortless sipping. Snap it shut and the double-wall vacuum insulation will keep your drink fully contained thanks to the leakproof mechanism and cold for 7 hours, as well as, iced for 35 hours. It fits comfortably in your car or bike cup holder, treadmills and spin cycles, too! The folding handle lets you quickly grab and go. To make your life easy, the IceFlow™ Tumblers are designed to clean easily. Every piece of this stainless steel water bottle is dishwasher safe. Available in different colours to mix or match with our vacuum bottles, food jars, and mugs.

  • 18/8 Stainless Steel
  • Double-Wall Vacuum Insulation
  • Naturally BPA Free
  • Dishwasher Safe
  • Lifetime Warranty

products.body:
The product to support your commute and on-the-go lifestyle. As a part of our Transit collection, the Aerolight™ Transit Mug is designed to be lightweight without compromising your desired liquid temperature. Keeping your drinks hot for 6 hours, or cold for 8 hours. If you are on a morning commute or an evening hike this product has you covered whatever the weather. The Bottle is also Leakproof, with a locking, drink-through lid. This means you do not have to worry about spills as you throw your bottle in your bag and jump on your commuter train or begin your exercise. In addition, the AeroLight™ is dishwasher safe and BPA free, designed for easy cleaning. Our commuter-friendly Transit Mugs are 33% lighter than Stanley’s standard stainless-steel metal drinkware.

Specifications

Weight: 180g
Dimensions: 163 H x 69 W x 69 L mm

Details:

  • AeroLight™ feather weight insulation
  • Double-wall vacuum insulation
  • 18/8 stainless steel; naturally BPA-free
  • Leakproof
  • Locking, drink-through lid
  • Car cup holder compatible
  • Dishwasher safe

products.body:
The Quencher FlowState Tumbler, your on-the-go hydration hero! Splash-proof and featuring double-walled vacuum insulation, it keeps beverages cool for 11 hours, hot for 7 hours, and iced for 2 days. Its advanced lid offers multiple drink openings, and the ergonomic handle makes it a comfortable carry. Plus, it fits cosy in your car cup holder. Stay effortlessly refreshed wherever you go!

 

  • The Quencher FlowState Tumbler, 1.18L
  • Conveniently splash proof
  • Double-walled vacuum insulation — stays cool for up to 11 hours, hot for up to 7 hours and iced for 2 days
  • Advanced FlowState screw-on lid features a rotating cover with a straw opening, a drink opening and a full-cover top
  • Ergonomic handle with comfort-grip inserts for easy carrying
  • Fits snugly in your cup car holder
  • Dimensions:
    • Product: 9.8cm L x 14.8cm W x 31.2cm H
    • Straw: 1cm Dia x 30cm H
    • Base: 8cm Dia
    • Handle: 3cm L x 1.8cm W x 12.5 H
  • Weight: 0.6kg
  • Capacity: 1.18L
  • Material:
    • Bottle: 90% Recycled 18/8 stainless steel, powder coat finish
    • Lid: BPA-free plastic
    • Straw: BPA-free plastic

 

Care Instructions

 

  • Dishwasher safe
  • Don't microwave
  • Wash all parts in warm, soapy water and then rinse clean before use
